book.name: Matiu
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Matiu Le Rorori

content: Jisas iŋa nevole thɨ raka Ŋgolo Boboma
Jisas vama i iteteŋa Ŋgolo Boboma ghayayao mbaŋaniye gharaghambu thɨ menawe na thɨ vatomweya Ŋgolo Bobomako ŋgoloŋgoloniyeŋgi.
Iŋa, “Ŋgoreiye, iya hu thuweŋgiya bigibigiko wolaghɨye. Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, mavole varɨ regha ne i ndeghathɨ ele ghamba ndeghathɨko, wolaghɨyeko nevole thɨ bigiyathuvao bode.”
Jisas iŋa gharaghambuko nevole thɨ vaidiŋgiya vuyowo laghɨye moli

Jisas va i yaku Olivɨ e ghanji Ou mbe ghambereghaeŋge na gharaghambu thɨ rakamenawe. Thɨ vaito, thɨŋa, “U utugiya weime ne thembaŋa bigibigike thiyake iya mo utuŋama weime thɨ yomara na thambo nono ne i woraŋgiya weime mbaŋa ne len mena na yambaneke le ghambako?”
Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi, iŋa, “Hu njimbukiki wagiyaweŋga, tha lolo regha i yaroŋga.
Kaiwae gharɨgharɨ i ghanagha ne thɨ mena e idaŋgu na thɨŋa, ‘Ghino Mesaiya!’ na ne thɨ yaroŋgiya gharɨgharɨ i ghanagha.
Ne hu loŋweŋgiya vanautuma lenji gaithɨ utuniye na toto gaithɨ kaiwae, ko ne hu ndemararu. Bigibigike thiyake ne thɨ yomara, ko ma ghanjirumwaru ŋgoreiye mbaŋa kaero le ghambako.
Vanautuma ne thɨ vegaithɨ weŋgi; rambarombaro ne thɨ vegaithɨ weŋgi. Nevole vunuvu na ragheragheghe lemoyo e yambaneke laghɨye.
Bigibigike wolaghɨye thiyake ŋgoreiya wevo ŋgamoiye i njivunɨkai vara ghambɨ kaiwae.”
“Nevole thɨ laweŋga na thɨ vaŋgugiyaŋga weŋgiya rambarombaro na thɨ gaboŋga. Gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye ne thɨ botewoyathuŋga idaŋgu kaiwae.
E mbaŋako iyako gharɨgharɨ lemoyo ne thɨ botewo lenji loŋweghathɨ na ne thɨ vevatomweŋgi na thɨ vebotewoŋgi.
Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu kwanɨkwan lemoyo ne thɨ rakaraŋgi na thɨ yaroŋgiya gharɨgharɨ lemoyo.
Kaiwae tharɨ ghavakatha ne i mbuthu na i yala, gharɨgharɨ lemoyo lenji gharethovu ne i nasiye weŋgiya lenji valɨgharɨgharɨ.
Ko thela ne i ghataŋaghathɨŋgiya vuyowoke thiyake na gheghada le ghambako ne i vaidiya vamoru.
Na Totoke Thovuye iyake Loi le ghamba mbaro utuutuniye ne thɨ vavaghareŋa e yambaneke laghɨye na gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye thɨ ghareghare amba muyai mbaŋa le ghambako i mena.”
Vuyowo laghɨye tene i mena

“Mbaŋa ne hu thuweya bigiko i vambɨghɨya Ŋgolo Boboma na i vakatha gharɨgharɨ thɨ roitetako, na i ndeghathɨ ŋgoreiye ma valɨkaiwae i ndeghathɨwe, iya Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu Daniyel va i utuŋama. (Ghemi bukuke iyake gharavavaona wo hu rerenuwaŋa ghaghadɨ nuwamina i rumwaruŋa utuke iyake!)
E mbaŋako iyako thavala inanji Judiya e tɨne thɨ rakavo na thɨ wa e ououko rɨgherɨghenji.
Lolo ina ele ŋgolo vwatae na i nja thava i ru e ŋgolo tɨne na i wo bigi regha. Mbema i vo eŋge.
Na lolo i kakaiwo e uma tɨne ne i ndenjogha e ghemba na i liya ghakwama ghayaboyabo.
Ne e mbaŋaŋgiko thiyako, ne i vuyowo laghɨye moli weŋgiya wanakau maramarabo na wanakau weinjiyaŋgiya gamagai amba thɨ thuthu!
Hu naŋgo weya Loi mbala ma hu vo mbaŋa ne njighɨnjighɨ ghambaŋa o ne Sabat.
Vuyowo ne e mbaŋako iyako ne i laghɨye, i laghɨye moli. Na vuyowoko ŋgoranjiyako ma mbaŋa regha i yomara e yambaneke va i rikowe gheghada noroke, na ma tene ŋgoreiyeva mbaŋa muyai.
Thoŋgo ma Loi i wonjoŋa mbaŋa le molamolao, mbala ma lolo regha i moru. Ko le tututhi gharɨgharɨniye kaiwae, Loi ne i wonjoŋa vuyowo ghambaŋa le molamolao.”
“Thoŋgo lolo regha i dage e ghemi iŋa, ‘Wo hu thuwe, Mesaiya maiya!’ o ‘Maiyako!’ ne hu ndeloŋweghathɨ.

Kaiwae Mesaiya kwanɨkwan na Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu kwanɨkwan ne thɨ rakaraŋgi na thɨ vakathaŋgiya vakatha ghamba rotaele i ghanagha na thɨ wo gharɨgharɨ nuwanji, na thɨ munje tembe thɨ wova Loi le tututhi gharɨgharɨniye nuwanji.
Wo hu thuwe, amba ŋgaŋgagha kaero ya giya yanawami.”
“Thoŋgo lolo regha i dage weŋga iŋa, ‘Maiyako, e njamnjam bwaga!’ Thava hu wa gheko. O thoŋgo iŋa, ‘Mbeiya e ŋgoloke,’ ne hu ndeloŋweghathɨ.
Kaiwae Lolo Nariye le mena ne ŋgoreiya i vilamema, i vilame yavorowoko na manjamanjalawae i wa ve wo bodeoko.”
“Bigi maremare aŋga inae ma rawowoidi thɨ rakavathavathawe.”
Lolo Nariye le mena
“Vuyowo e mbaŋaŋgiko thiyako e ghereiye varae mara ne i momouwo, manjala mane i mbɨle, ghɨtara ne thɨ dobu e buruburu na buruburu matemate ne thiya nyivɨvao.

Amba Lolo Nariye le mena ghanono ne i yomara e buruburu, na gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye e yambaneke thiya randa, mbaŋa ne thɨ thuweya Lolo Nariye i njama e ŋgalɨlɨ vwatanji, weiye le vurɨgheghe na vwenyevwenye laghɨye.

Ne thɨ wiya mema na ghalɨŋae laghɨye moli amba i variyeŋgiya le nyao thovuthovuye e yambaneke ghadidiye gethɨvarɨ na thɨ vaŋguvathavathaŋgiya le tututhi gharɨgharɨniye e yambaneke mbothiye regha gheghada valɨmbothiye.”
Hu wo vavaghare weya fig
“Lemi ghamba ghareghare thovuye hu wo weya umbwa fig. Mbaŋa hu thuwe ndamwandamwa thɨ thalavwara, hu ghareghareya mbaŋa nasiye thuwai ghambaŋa.
Tembe ŋgoreiyeva, mbaŋa ne hu thuweŋgiya bigibigike thiyake thɨ yoyomara, hu ghareghare le njoghama ghambaŋa ma bwagabwaga, maiyavara.
Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi thake iyake mamba ne thiya marevao ghaghad bigibigike wolaghɨye thiyake thɨ yomara.
Buruburu na yambane ne thɨko, ko ghalɨŋaŋguke mane iko.”
Ma lolo regha i ghareghare thembaŋa Lolo Nariye ne i mena

“Ma lolo regha i ghareghare thembaŋa na the lughawoghawo Lolo Nariye ne i menawe. Nyao thovuthovuye e buruburu ma thɨ ghareghare, Nariye ma i ghareghare, mbe Ramae ghamberegha eŋge i ghareghare ne thembaŋa.
Ghaghad thembaŋa Lolo Nariye ne i mena, gharɨgharɨ ne lenji vakatha ŋgoreiya thɨ vakatha Nowa va ghambaŋa.
Va e mbaŋaŋgiko thiyako amba muyai ŋgonuŋgo i voru na i thotho, gharɨgharɨ thɨ ghanɨŋga na thɨ munumu, ghɨmoghɨmoru na wanakau thɨ ghe, ghaghad vara e mbaŋaniye Nowa i tha e waŋgama.
Ma va thɨ ghareghare, ŋgonuŋgo na thotho raitharɨ regha maiyavara e ghamwanjina. I mena na i gabovaoŋgi. Iyako ne ŋgoreiye mbaŋa Lolo Nariye ne le mena.
E mbaŋako iyako ghɨmoghɨmoru thenjighewo ne thɨ kaiwo e uma tɨne: regha ne thɨ yovaŋgu, na regha ne thɨ itete.
Wanakau theunyiwo ne inanji wit ghamba vakatha thɨ vwaŋgoŋgo wit: eunda ne thɨ yovaŋgu na eunda ne thɨ itete.
Iya kaiwae hu njaŋanja, kaiwae ma hu ghareghare thembaŋa ghami Giya ne i mena.
Hu renuwaŋakikiya iyake: thoŋgo ŋgolo tanuwagae va i ghareghareya thembaŋa ghalughawoghawo rakaivɨ ne i vuthawe, ne i njaŋanjaŋa ele ŋgoloko na rakaivɨko tha i ruwe.
Ghemi tembe ŋgoreiyeva hu vivatha na mbema hu roroghagha eŋge, kaiwae Lolo Nariye ne i mena e lughawoghawo, ma hu ghareghare ne i menawe.”
Rakakaiwo thovuye na rakakaiwo raitharɨ
“Ghemi mbala ŋgoramiya rakakaiwo i manabu na e ghavareminje iya ghagiya i worawe na i njimbukikiŋgiya rakakaiwo na i giya ghanji, ghanɨŋga e ghambaŋa moli.
Ne i thovuye moli weya rakakaiwoko iyako thoŋgo ghagiya i vutha na i vaidiya i vakatha ŋgoraiyako.
Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, ne i worawe na i mbaroŋaŋgiya le bigibigiko wolaghɨye.
Ko thoŋgo iye rakakaiwo raitharɨ ne i renuwaŋa e ghare na iŋa, ‘O giyama mane i vutha rukuruku,’
amba i yabɨbɨŋgiya le valɨrakakaiwoko na i ghanɨŋga na i munumu weiyaŋgiya ramunumu.
Mbaŋa regha rakakaiwoma ghagiya i njoghama, i vathɨna ghare kaiwae rakakaiwoma mane i ghareghare thembaŋa na the lughawoghawo giyama ne i njoghamawe.
Ghagiya ne i vutha i ŋge na i tagavotagamenawe, na i vaŋgurawe gharɨgharɨ raraitharɨ na rakwanɨŋgi e lenji lithɨ ghembaniye, ghakaiwo randa na thɨ rɨghɨmbiya ŋiŋiye.”
